name: audit2 Error-annotated callback param receives a real Error
source: import { EventEmitter } from "node:events"; function main(): void { const ee = new EventEmitter(); ee.on("error", (er: Error) => console.log("ee", er.message, er instanceof Error, er.name)); ee.emit("error", new RangeError("boom")); const ac = new AbortController(); ac.signal.addEventListener("abort", () => { const r = ac.signal.reason as Error; console.log("abort", r.name, r instanceof Error); }); ac.abort(); }
